title: Dogfooding round 1 hardening
body: Six small gaps surfaced by dogfooding `asf` (Rust workspace that dispatches Claude Code workers into git worktrees). (1) `gh sync` must ignore remote issues authored by someone other than the authenticated GitHub user and report them in a `foreign` field; (2) `asf doctor` gets a `github` check that depends on `[merge] target`; (3) a new `asf lane clean <id> [--dry-run]` removes a finished worktree without `--force`, keeping the branch; `worktree_remove` also accepts rebase-merged branches via `git cherry`; (4) gates whose output contains `LNK1104` are retried up to 3 attempts with a 3 s pause, reported via `GateResult.attempts`; (5) `asf plan new` renders a `Language:` line from `[methodology] language` into both planner prompts; (6) `asf plan new` takes its prompt stages and schemas from the active methodology (embedded builtins or local manifests) instead of four `include_str!` constants. Shared struct changes (`GhIssue.author`, `GateResult.attempts`, both `#[serde(default)]`) land first in one foundation task so the parallel tracks stay file-disjoint. Out of scope: Vcs trait, ports.rs, Cargo manifests, spec-kit/superpowers manifests, new CLI commands beyond `lane clean`, TUI, retries on anything but LNK1104.

title: Add GhIssue.author and GateResult.attempts fields (serde default) and fix all construction sites
body: Foundation task; no behaviour change. (a) Add `#[serde(default)] pub author: <type>` to `GhIssue` in `crates/asf-core/src/github.rs` (line ~60). Use `String` defaulting to empty (an empty author never equals `whoami`, so unknown authors are treated as foreign; fail-closed). Match the existing style of neighbouring string fields. (b) Add `#[serde(default)] pub attempts: u32` to `GateResult` in `crates/asf-core/src/vcs.rs` (line ~72). Default 0 means 'not run / unknown' for deserialised legacy records; runners set it to the real attempt count. (c) Fix EVERY struct-literal site in one pass before compiling: `crates/asf-core/src/run.rs:205`, `crates/asf-vcs/src/gates.rs:43` and `:104` (set `attempts: 1` in run_gate's paths, no retry logic yet), `crates/asf-vcs/src/gh.rs:123`, `crates/asf-vcs/src/fake_github.rs:231`, `crates/asf-store/tests/runs.rs:155`. Verify with Grep for `GhIssue {` and `GateResult {` across `crates/` before running cargo. Do NOT implement author fetching (task 2) or retry (task 5).

acceptance.text: `cargo build --workspace` succeeds with no remaining `GhIssue {` or `GateResult {` literal missing the new field (grep verified).
`cargo test --workspace` passes unchanged (no new behaviour asserted).
A JSON record without `author` / `attempts` deserialises with the default value (unit test next to the type, TDD RED then GREEN).
`cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

title: gh sync: whoami and foreign-issue filter
body: Implement `GitHub::whoami(&self) -> Result<String, _>` on the GitHub port (trait in `crates/asf-core/src/github.rs`). Fake (`crates/asf-vcs/src/fake_github.rs`) returns `me`. Real impl in `crates/asf-vcs/src/gh.rs` runs `gh api user --jq .login`. Extend `issue_list` in `gh.rs` to request `author` in `gh issue list --json ...,author` and fill `GhIssue.author` (field added in task 1). In the `gh sync` command (locate via Grep for `foreign`/`mirror` under `crates/asf/src/commands/`), a remote issue whose author differs from `whoami()` is never used as a mirror and is listed in the new output field `foreign: [{id, number, author}]`. If `whoami()` fails, abort with a backend error (exit 1); do not treat every issue as foreign. Do not change mirror or uid semantics beyond this filter. Write tests first (RED). Use thiserror in libraries, anyhow only in the binary. Emit the `--json` envelope.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf-vcs --test github` passes, including a case where a foreign-authored remote issue is excluded from mirroring and appears in `foreign`.
`cargo test -p asf --test cli_github` passes; output JSON contains `foreign` with `id`, `number`, `author`.
When fake `whoami` errors, `gh sync` exits 1 with a backend error and mirrors nothing.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: Doctor github check driven by [merge] target
body: Add a `github` check to `asf doctor`. When `[merge] target = "github"`, the check is required: it runs `gh auth status` (ok on exit 0, fail otherwise) and `git remote get-url <remote>` (ok when it resolves). When target is `local`, the check is `warn`/skipped and never fails the command. Locate the existing doctor implementation via Grep for `doctor` under `crates/asf/src/commands/` and follow its check/result pattern. Do not add new CLI commands. Write tests first (RED), covering: github target with ok gh, github target with failing `gh auth status`, local target.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf --test cli_repo` covers github target success, github target with failing `gh auth status` (check fails, exit 1), and local target (warn/skipped, command does not fail).
JSON output includes the github check with a detail string taken from `gh auth status` / `git remote get-url`.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: worktree_remove: accept rebase-merged branches via git cherry; refuse empty branches on that path
body: Extend `Vcs::worktree_remove` implementation in `crates/asf-vcs/src/git.rs` (line ~91; it is also called from `worker.rs:283`, keep its signature and behaviour for that caller). A branch counts as merged when the existing ancestor check passes OR when `git cherry <base> <branch>` prints no `+` lines AND `git rev-list --count <base>..<branch>` > 0 (resolved open question 2: a fresh lane with zero commits ahead must NOT count as merged). Keep the ancestor path unchanged. Do NOT modify the `Vcs` trait or `crates/asf-core/src/ports.rs`. Do not delete branches. Write tests first in `crates/asf-vcs/tests/git.rs`: rebase-merged branch is removable; branch with unique commits is refused; branch with zero commits ahead is refused.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf-vcs --test git` passes with the three cases above (rebase-merged removable, unique commits refused, zero commits ahead refused).
Existing worker cleanup tests (`cargo test --workspace`) still pass.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: asf lane clean <id> [--dry-run]
body: Add `Clean { id, dry_run }` to `LaneCmd` in `crates/asf/src/cli.rs` (line ~395) and implement it in `crates/asf/src/commands/lane.rs`. Behaviour: refuse with conflict (exit 3) while the issue is claimed or the worktree is dirty; otherwise call `worktree_remove` on `<worktrees_dir>/<id>` WITHOUT force, keep the branch, return `{id, worktree, removed}` in the `--json` envelope. `--dry-run` returns `removed: false` and changes nothing. No `--force`, no branch deletion, no removal of claimed lanes. Use task 4's merged-detection via `worktree_remove`. Write tests first in `crates/asf/tests/cli_lane.rs`.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf --test cli_lane` covers: clean of finished lane removes the worktree and keeps the branch; claimed lane refused with exit 3; dirty worktree refused with exit 3; `--dry-run` reports `removed: false` and leaves the worktree in place.
`asf lane --help` lists `clean` with `--dry-run`; no `--force` flag exists.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: Retry gates on LNK1104 (3 attempts, 3 s pause)
body: In `crates/asf-vcs/src/gates.rs`: when a gate's output contains `LNK1104`, rerun it after a 3 s pause, up to 3 attempts total. The returned `GateResult` keeps the last attempt's output and sets `attempts`. Other failures run exactly once. Timeouts are not retried. `run_gates` (line ~114, stops at first failure) keeps the 3 s default; introduce an internal runner that takes a delay parameter so tests do not wait 3 s per retry. Tests use a scripted command (a small script or shell one-liner that prints `LNK1104` a fixed number of times), never a real linker. Write tests first in `crates/asf-vcs/tests/gates.rs`.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf-vcs --test gates` covers: prints LNK1104 once then succeeds -> ok, attempts 2; always prints LNK1104 -> not ok, attempts 3; fails without LNK1104 -> attempts 1.
Public `run_gates` signature unchanged; default delay is 3 s.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: plan new: manifest-driven prompt stages and schemas
body: Refactor `crates/asf/src/commands/plan.rs`: resolve the active methodology through `commands::method` (`crates/asf/src/commands/method.rs`, `BUILTIN` at lines ~18-39, local manifests from `.factory/methodologies/<name>/` at ~149). Take `prompt` stages in manifest order; load each stage's prompt and schema from the methodology (embedded for builtins, from disk for local ones). Remove the four `include_str!` constants at `plan.rs:18-21`. The request builder (`plan.rs:297-306`) must receive the stage's prompt text instead of the constants. Existing `cli_plan` tests must pass UNCHANGED. Add a new test with a local methodology whose `idea-to-prd.md` differs from the builtin and assert the fake planner receives that text. No new stage kinds; do not touch spec-kit or superpowers manifests. Write the new test first (RED).

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf --test cli_plan` passes; pre-existing tests are not edited.
New test: local methodology with custom `idea-to-prd.md` -> fake planner receives that exact text.
`grep include_str` in `plan.rs` returns nothing for the four prompt/schema constants.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.

title: Language line in planner prompts via {{language}} placeholder
body: Read `[methodology] language` from the active manifest (default `en`) in `crates/asf/src/commands/plan.rs` (available after task 7 refactor). Render a `Language: <code>` line into both prompts through a `{{language}}` placeholder added to `methodologies/asf-default/prompts/idea-to-prd.md` and `methodologies/asf-default/prompts/prd-to-issues.md`. Do not change spec-kit or superpowers manifests. Decision on open question 1: 'byte-for-byte identical' means identical to the post-change rendering; the language line is the only intended difference from the pre-change asf-default rendering. Write the test first in `crates/asf/tests/cli_plan.rs`: fake planner receives a prompt containing `Language: en`.

acceptance.text: `cargo test -p asf --test cli_plan` asserts the rendered prompt contains `Language: en` for both stages.
A manifest with `language = "pl"` renders `Language: pl`; missing key renders `en`.
Prompt diff versus pre-change asf-default is exactly the language placeholder/line.
Gates from the brief pass for the whole workspace.
